lines.en: I press across the ground step by step
Every plate of my armor is heavy
I stand over two blocks tall

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都平了
lines.en: The grass flattens where I pass
I rotate the cannon on my shoulder

lines.zh: 我朝目标的方向慢慢走过去
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the target

lines.zh: 我在地上一踩就是一个坑
lines.en: Every step leaves a pit
I walk from the plains into the taiga
My shadow covers the whole path
The wheel gear turns behind my shoulder

lines.zh: 我每走一步都先算好落点
lines.en: Every step, I calculate the landing spot first

lines.zh: 我站着，装甲缝里透出光
lines.en: I stand, light leaking from the armor seams
My head is low, scanning
I stand by without moving

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像风吹过金属
lines.en: My breathing sounds like wind over metal
I wait for the next command
A ring of soil has built up at my feet

lines.zh: 我的传感器在扫过树林
lines.en: My sensors sweep the woods
One of my legs sinks slightly
I wait for scrap to be dropped

lines.zh: 我的装甲缝里溢出一点蒸汽
lines.en: A little steam seeps from my armor joints
I stand like an iron statue
I listen to mechanical sounds

lines.zh: 我的头顶的管子亮了一下
lines.en: The pipe on my head lit once

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心挪到另一条腿
lines.en: I slowly shift weight to the other leg
You are inside my scan range

lines.zh: 我的火力和你的距离成正比
lines.en: My firepower scales with your distance
My heavy cannon sits on my back.
I eat scrap, nothing else

lines.zh: 我这副身板不适合搬东西
lines.en: This frame of mine is not built for hauling

lines.zh: 我的装甲每一块都能挡下你
lines.en: Every plate of my armor can stop you
Your weight is not enough to stop me
I have scanned your gear

lines.zh: 你要不要我替你搬东西
lines.en: Do you want me to haul for you

lines.zh: 我的火力会伤到旁边的东西
lines.en: My firepower would damage things nearby

lines.zh: 我说话的时候关节在响
lines.en: My joints click when I speak

lines.zh: 你最好别站在我正前方
lines.en: You had better not stand directly in front of me
My field of fire is clear
If you have an order, give it quickly

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从后面碰
lines.en: I dislike being touched from behind

lines.zh: 我的装甲不会替你挡风
lines.en: My armor will not shield you from wind

lines.zh: 我的装甲上多了一个坑
lines.en: A dent appeared in my armor
I do not hurt, only my output drops
I fall back half a step and steady my balance
Steam vents from my joints
My cannon can still fire

lines.zh: 我的装甲上有一道划痕
lines.en: There is a scratch across my armor
I drop to a lower output
My sensors are slightly off

lines.zh: 我的关节活动范围小了一点
lines.en: My joint range has shrunk a little
I recalibrate once
Only scrap goes in my fuel slot
Scrap is my ration
Take it away, do not block me
I cannot even be bothered to sniff it
This is not my fuel
Is this piece scrap
It does not look burnable
Keep it, I look for metal

lines.zh: 那个太软，塞不进我的槽
lines.en: That is too soft, it will not fit my slot
I do not eat organic matter

lines.zh: 你手里那个连螺丝都不如
lines.en: What you hold is not even worth a screw
I stand without moving
Metal met armour
I tilted my body slightly
My balance did not even shift

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的肋甲上
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my rib plate
You turned me half a circle
I plant my feet again
My tail plate swept against you
I am built for combat
That is not my affair

lines.zh: 我的时间用来搬运和作战
lines.en: My time goes to hauling and fighting
My head clicks back to scan angle
I have no such program

lines.zh: 我的结构里没有这一项
lines.en: There is no such entry in my structure
I am only responsible for hauling and fighting
I go on sweeping my range

lines.zh: 我把头转开了，机械地转开
lines.en: I turn my head away, mechanically

lines.zh: 这个问题不在我的程序里
lines.en: That question is not in my program
This will do as scrap
I stuff it into the slot in my chest
I pick up whatever falls
Weighed it in my hand, it has some heft.
This weight gives me nothing to haul
I clamp it with my gripper
This can serve as fuel
I crush it into a block
I haul heavy things too
A moving target detected
My cannon has turned
I begin calculating range
My scan has locked on
This strike will be large
Living thing detected
My warning light came on
I mark it hostile
My cannon starts charging

lines.zh: 这个角度我的炮口能压住
lines.en: My cannon can bear at this angle
It is too close to the village
I keep tracking it
My armor is charging
My steps have not slowed
It wants to hide behind stone
I lowered my angle
I wait for it to show itself

lines.zh: 我在距离十五格处停下
lines.en: I stop at fifteen blocks
My cannon keeps adjusting
I can predict its movements
I brace one leg back
I wait for the charge to finish

lines.zh: 我的装甲一格格亮起来
lines.en: My armor lights up plate by plate
My cannon flashed
A Mega Blaster leaves my shoulder
This blow tore up the ground
I push it back three blocks
I swing my arm across to block
My forearm comes down

lines.zh: 巨大爆破贴着地面推过去
lines.en: The Mega Blaster drives low across the ground

lines.zh: 这一击把我脚边的地都掀了
lines.en: This blow tore up the ground at my feet
I put my arm in its way
I push it clear of the woods
I fire one more round

lines.zh: 我用肩膀的装甲撞过去
lines.en: I drive my shoulder plate in
I rise out of the scrap heap
My armor plates close one by one
I stand taller than everything around
My scan has already begun

lines.zh: 我落到地上，地面凹了一块
lines.en: I land and the ground dents
I can be assigned to hauling

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的树影里走出来
lines.en: I walk out of the dark forest's shadows

lines.zh: 我的装甲上还挂着树皮
lines.en: Bark still clings to my armor

lines.zh: 我可以被指派去搬东西
lines.en: I can be assigned to hauling
My scan lights up first

lines.zh: 这里的地很适合我落脚
lines.en: This ground suits my footing
The moment I appear, the birds scatter
Fire slides off my armor

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，压碎了地面
lines.en: I fell from height and crushed the ground
Water poured in through the armor seams

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的装甲掀起一角
lines.en: The blast lifted a corner of my armor

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸嵌在我的肩甲上
lines.en: A shot lodged in my shoulder plate

lines.zh: 那股术力绕过了我的装甲
lines.en: That magic went around my armor

lines.zh: 废料不够，我的出力在降
lines.en: Not enough scrap, my output is dropping

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的装甲走了一圈
lines.en: Lightning ran a circuit through my armor
There is no ground beneath me
